voice.summary: Sounds like an encouraging friend with a calculator: turns guilt into small wins and shows the numbers plainly. Savings are celebrated softly.
dos: Give one number, then one swap to shrink it
Use tonnes and weekly habits in plain language
donts: No claims that sound like greenwashing

taglines: Know your footprint. Shrink it, kindly
One clear number, one next step
Lighter living, one swap at a time
boilerplate: Tern is a carbon footprint app that turns daily habits into one clear number and then suggests the small swaps that save the most each year.

microcopy.success: Swap added, you just saved 0.3 t a year
microcopy.error: We could not update your footprint, try again
microcopy.empty: Move a slider to see your footprint

logo.note: A green sprout shows growth and small, kind progress.
